Sedan.label: Sedan
Sedan.desc: Three-box notchback architecture with separated trunk, cabin, and engine compartments.

Coupe.label: Coupe
Coupe.desc: Low-slung two-door sports silhouette characterized by a steeply raked roofline and sleek stance.

SUV.label: SUV / Crossover
SUV.desc: High-riding, tall-cabin silhouette with elevated ground clearance and upright utility stance.

Wagon.label: Station Wagon
Wagon.desc: Extended two-box roofline running to a vertical tailgate for maximized volumetric rear space.

Hatchback.label: Hatchback
Hatchback.desc: Compact two-box profile with an integrated rear liftback door and short overhangs.

Convertible.label: Convertible
Convertible.desc: Open-top roadsters and dropheads with a minimal waistline and low greenhouse profile.

Pickup.label: Pickup Truck
Pickup.desc: Enclosed front passenger cab paired with an open cargo utility bed.

Van.label: Van / Minivan
Van.desc: High-volume mono-volume cabin maximizing passenger rows and vertical head space.
